newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka unit trust declares dividend.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka unit trust declares dividend.

text.p: Sri Lanka's National Asset Management Ltd (NAMAL) said in a statement on Tuesday it had declared a tax-free dividend of 75 cents per unit for the year to February for the National Equity Fund.
"Dividend is declared at the end of February so that investors can take it into their books for the financial year ending March 31," said S. Jeyavarman, deputy general manager, NAMAL.

Development Finance Corporation of Ceylon Ltd, the state-owned People's Bank, Employees' Trust Fund, Asian Development Bank and Capital International of the USA jointly own the fund, which is managed by NAMAL.
The fund now stands at 1.1 billion rupees, with 59 percent invested in equities and the balance in fixed income securities, Jeyavarman said.
